title: onprem/airgap: vendor offline bundle for RKE2 + SLES support
author: Ava Chen
description: Motivation: Customers deploying Redwood Private on RKE2 clusters running SUSE Linux Enterprise Server (SLES) need a supported offline bundle and vendoring for air-gapped installs. This PR adds first-class SLES support to the onprem/airgap offline bundle and vendor pipeline. Changes include: vendor SLES-specific package set (containerd, runc, rke2 runtime deps, kernel modules) into installer/offline-bundles/rke2/sles/, add distro manifest and post-install hooks (sysctl, udev rules), update Helm chart and installer templates to recognize sles as a supported distro, and add an automated CI smoke job that runs the airgap installer flow against an RKE2 SLES VM. Checklist: [x] Vendor SLES packages into bundle; [x] Add distro manifest and templates; [x] Helm chart + installer templating updates; [x] Add CI smoke job and docs; [x] Manual validation on SLES 15 SP3 VM. Testing & validation: validated install/upgrade/rollback flows on an internal RKE2 SLES VM and ran new CI job (airgap-smoke-sles) in the pipeline. Related work: ENG-1245 (distro coverage), PM-982 (onprem installer roadmap). Notes: this change keeps all existing rke2/ubuntu and rke2/flatcar paths unchanged; no breaking API changes to installer config. See comments for CI rerun and minor follow-ups.
commits: initial: vendor SLES package tarball and add manifest
installer: add rke2/sles manifest + post-install hooks
helm: allow 'sles' in installer distro selector and templates
ci: add airgap-smoke-sles job and test playbook
docs: document SLES requirements and known limitations
fix: adjust permissions on vendored binaries per SLES expectations

Ava Chen: Thanks Liam. I split the vendor-only artifacts into a dedicated commit and added checksum verification to scripts/vendor/generate-bundle.sh. The tarball is reproducible and stripped as part of the pipeline.
Priya Rao: CI failed on first run due to missing zypper mirror in the test VM, reran with mirror set and airgap-smoke-sles passed. Please add a note in docs about mirror requirements.
Ava Chen: Added mirror requirements to docs/onprem/airgap/sles.md and updated the CI job to export ZYPPER_MIRROR for the VM used in the smoke test.
Diego Martinez: Approving pending the small permission fix on installer/templates/rke2/sles-postinstall.yaml (executables must be 0755).
Ava Chen: Fixed permissions and pushed -- changed file list updated. Ready to merge.
release_notes: Add SLES support to onprem air-gapped offline bundle for RKE2; vendors SLES-specific packages; adds CI smoke test and docs. This enables customers running RKE2 on SUSE Linux Enterprise Server to perform air-gapped installs and upgrades with Redwood Private.
summary: Adds SLES distribution support to the onprem airgap installer, vendors required packages into offline bundle, updates Helm templates, and adds CI smoke test and docs.
